fiche: Petit diablotin né d'une braise tombée, il hante les foyers des volcans et les cheminées abandonnées.
apparence: Small imp with charcoal skin cracked by glowing ember lines, stubby horns, flame tuft on the head; colors red, black and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A round black coal-ball with big glowing orange eyes, two tiny nub horns and a single flickering flame on top.
stades.enfant: Short stubby legs and little clawed arms appear, plus a thin pointed tail ending in a spark.
stades.ado: The body stretches into a lanky imp with longer curved horns, pointed ears and tiny bat-wing buds on the back.
stades.adulte: A wiry imp with small membranous red wings, sharp black claws, a spade-tipped tail and a blazing flame crest.
stades.ancien: An elder imp with a long ash-grey beard of smoke, chipped horns hung with tiny brass rings and a glowing ember cane.

fiche: Chiot infernal aux cornes brûlantes qui garde les entrées des grottes volcaniques et des ruines calcinées.
apparence: Hound-like demon with sooty fur, curling horns and glowing paws; colors black, deep red and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A round fluffy black puppy with huge orange eyes, floppy ears and two tiny red horn nubs.
stades.enfant: Legs lengthen, the horns curl into small spirals and the paw pads start glowing like embers.
stades.ado: A lean hound body with a spiky ridge of red bone plates along the spine and a whip tail with a flame tip.
stades.adulte: A muscular demon hound with large ram-like horns, a mane of living fire, obsidian claws and a spiked tail.
stades.ancien: An old grizzled hound with a smoky grey muzzle, cracked horns wrapped in iron chains and a dim halo of embers.

fiche: Insecte démoniaque attiré par toutes les flammes, il bourdonne en essaims au-dessus des coulées de lave.
apparence: Fly-like demon with a fuzzy black body, translucent membranous wings with red veins and glowing compound eyes; colors black, red and orange.

stades.bebe: A round fuzzy black ball with two giant glowing orange eyes and two tiny stub wings.
stades.enfant: Thin legs and a pair of short feelers appear, and the wings become small red membranes.
stades.ado: The body splits into head, thorax and a striped orange abdomen, with a second pair of wings and tiny horns.
stades.adulte: A large demon fly with four veined bat-like wings, a curved horn, mandible claws and a glowing stinger abdomen.
stades.ancien: An elder fly with tattered wings patched with ash, a long grey whisker-like antenna beard and a floating ember halo.

fiche: Salamandre démoniaque couverte de cendres, elle se terre sous les braises refroidies des anciens incendies.
apparence: Flat lizard-like demon with ash-grey crusted skin, glowing cracks and back spikes; colors grey-black, red and orange.

stades.bebe: A round flat ash-grey blob with stubby little legs, big sleepy orange eyes and a tiny ember on its nose.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens into a small salamander with a short tail and a row of tiny red spikes on the back.
stades.ado: Glowing lava cracks open across the skin, the claws grow long and two small backward horns appear.
stades.adulte: A long low-slung demon salamander with a thick ash crust armor, molten back spikes, a forked tongue and a club tail.
stades.ancien: An ancient salamander whose crust is mossy with soot and cracked like old stone, with a beard of hanging ash and relic chains.

fiche: Esprit démoniaque fait d'ombre et d'un sourire lumineux, il ricane dans les recoins sombres des cryptes.
apparence: Floating shadow demon with a wispy black body, a wide glowing grin and purple eyes; colors black, purple and red.

stades.bebe: A small round puff of black smoke with two big purple eyes and a tiny glowing smile.
stades.enfant: Two wispy arms with little claws appear and two small horn points rise from the head.
stades.ado: A tattered shadow cape forms around the body and the grin widens with jagged red glowing teeth.
stades.adulte: A large hooded shadow with long curved horns, long clawed hands, a huge grinning mouth and swirling purple flames below.
stades.ancien: An elder shadow wearing a cracked bone mask over its grin, with a crown of purple flame and dangling relic charms.

fiche: Serpent démoniaque qui exhale du soufre, il ondule dans les fissures fumantes autour des cratères.
apparence: Snake demon with glossy black scales, sulfur-yellow belly and orange glowing eyes; colors black, red and sulfur orange.

stades.bebe: A tiny round coiled snakelet with a big head, huge orange eyes and a little puff of yellow smoke.
stades.enfant: The body lengthens and two tiny red horn buds and a forked flame tongue appear.
stades.ado: A frilled hood of thin red membrane opens behind the head and a rattle of glowing stones grows on the tail.
stades.adulte: A long serpent with a wide spiked hood, two swept-back horns, smoking venom fangs and a burning ember tail tip.
stades.ancien: An elder serpent with faded cracked scales, long whisker barbels like a beard and a gold relic ring around its horns.

fiche: Forgeron des enfers aux bras en tisonniers, il martèle ses armes au cœur des forges volcaniques.
apparence: Stocky demon smith with blackened iron skin, a glowing furnace belly and tool-like arms; colors black, red and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A round iron-black pot-bellied baby with a glowing orange belly window, big eyes and tiny horn nubs.
stades.enfant: Short arms appear ending in little poker-shaped hooks and a small leather apron forms on the belly.
stades.ado: The shoulders widen, one arm becomes a small hammer head, and a chimney horn starts puffing smoke from the head.
stades.adulte: A broad demon blacksmith with a hammer arm and a poker-blade arm, a roaring furnace chest and two chimney horns.
stades.ancien: An old smith with a long braided beard of iron wire, soot-stained cracked plating and a glowing anvil pendant.

fiche: Masse de magma vivant qui bouillonne dans un chaudron fêlé, elle mijote dans les marais sulfureux.
apparence: Bubbling blob of dark magma living inside a cracked black cauldron; colors black, purple and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A small round blob of glowing orange goo with two big eyes, sitting in a tiny black bowl.
stades.enfant: The bowl becomes a little cauldron with stubby feet and the goo grows two dripping blobby arms.
stades.ado: Purple bubbles and two small horns of hardened magma rise from the goo, and the cauldron gets iron handles.
stades.adulte: A large cracked cauldron with clawed iron legs, overflowing with glowing magma that forms a horned face and grasping arms.
stades.ancien: An elder cauldron covered in runes and rust, a beard of hanging dried lava drips and a ring of floating ember skulls.

fiche: Mille-pattes démoniaque fait de maillons de fer chauffés à blanc, il serpente dans les ruines et les forges oubliées.
apparence: Centipede demon whose segments are red-hot iron chain links with spiky claw legs; colors black iron, red and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A round iron ball with big glowing eyes and four tiny stubby legs.
stades.enfant: Two more iron segments link behind the head, each with a pair of small hooked legs.
stades.ado: The body becomes a chain of many glowing links with sharp claw legs and curved pincer horns on the head.
stades.adulte: A long armored chain centipede with spiked links, blade-like legs, huge horned mandibles and a hook-tipped tail.
stades.ancien: An elder chain centipede with rusted links tied with relic padlocks, a mossy soot crust and a crown of ember spikes.

fiche: Gargouille démoniaque de pierre volcanique qui veille, immobile, sur les tours en ruine avant de s'envoler en flammes.
apparence: Gargoyle demon of black volcanic stone with glowing seams, membranous wings and a fanged face; colors black, dark red and orange.

stades.bebe: A round little stone pebble with big glowing orange eyes, tiny horns and two stubby wing nubs.
stades.enfant: Crouched little legs and arms appear and the wings grow into small stone-ribbed membranes.
stades.ado: The face grows a fanged snout, the horns curve backward and a stone tail with a spade tip appears.
stades.adulte: A large winged gargoyle with wide dark red membranous wings, crown of stone horns, fanged maw and molten cracks across its body.
stades.ancien: An ancient gargoyle covered in moss and deep cracks, a long stone beard and a broken relic chain around the neck.

fiche: Araignée démoniaque tissant des toiles d'ombre et de feu violet au fond des cryptes et des gouffres.
apparence: Spider demon with a glossy black carapace, purple flame web and many glowing red eyes; colors black, purple and red.

stades.bebe: A round black fuzzy ball with three big red eyes and six tiny stubby legs.
stades.enfant: Eight thin legs grow out and two small purple fangs and a tiny horn appear.
stades.ado: A horned upper torso with two clawed arms rises from the spider body, and the abdomen shows a glowing purple sigil.
stades.adulte: A large spider demon with a horned humanoid torso, eight blade-tipped legs, many red eyes and trailing purple fire webs.
stades.ancien: An elder spider with grey silk hair like a long beard, cracked carapace hung with bone relics and a violet flame halo.

fiche: Dragon démoniaque au souffle de soufre, il niche sur les cheminées des volcans en éruption.
apparence: Demonic dragon with black scales, red membranous wings, molten-glowing chest and twisted horns; colors black, red and orange.

stades.bebe: A round red egg-shaped hatchling with big orange eyes, tiny wing nubs and a small smoke puff from its nose.
stades.enfant: Four short legs and a stubby tail appear and the wings become small bat-like membranes.
stades.ado: The neck lengthens, two twisted horns grow, and a row of black spines runs from head to tail.
stades.adulte: A large winged demon dragon with huge tattered red wings, crown of twisted horns, glowing lava chest and spiked tail.
stades.ancien: An ancient dragon with ash-grey whisker beard, horns ringed with gold relics and scales cracked like cooled lava.

fiche: Destrier démoniaque aux sabots enflammés qui galope dans les brumes nocturnes et hante les rêves.
apparence: Demon horse with dark purple coat, mane and tail of violet fire, glowing red eyes and horns; colors black, purple and red.

stades.bebe: A round little foal with stubby legs, huge red eyes and a tiny wisp of purple flame for a mane.
stades.enfant: The legs grow long and wobbly, the hooves start burning and two small horn buds appear.
stades.ado: A slender horse body with a flaming mane, two curved horns and a thin spiked tail of fire.
stades.adulte: A powerful dark stallion with blazing violet mane and tail, long swept-back horns, bony armored face and burning hooves.
stades.ancien: An elder steed with a long silver smoke beard, cracked horns decorated with relic bells and a crescent moon halo.

fiche: Colosse démoniaque dont le dos est un volcan actif, il écrase tout sur son passage dans les plaines de lave.
apparence: Huge brute demon with obsidian rock body, a smoking crater on its back and lava veins; colors black, red and incandescent orange.

stades.bebe: A round obsidian pebble baby with big glowing eyes and a tiny smoking bump on its back.
stades.enfant: Thick stubby arms and legs appear and the bump becomes a small crater with lava bubbling inside.
stades.ado: Huge fists of rock form, two thick horns grow and lava veins spread across the chest.
stades.adulte: A towering hunched brute with giant rock fists, massive curved horns, a fanged jaw and an erupting volcano on its back.
stades.ancien: An ancient colossus with moss and ash on its shoulders, a dormant crater, a beard of cooled lava and relic totems.

fiche: Seigneur suprême des démons, il règne depuis un trône de lave au plus profond des ténèbres infernales.
apparence: Regal demon lord with black armored skin, a burning crown of horns, huge membranous wings and a flowing ember cape; colors black, red and royal purple.

stades.bebe: A round little black demon with big golden-red eyes, a tiny flame crown and a mini purple cape.
stades.enfant: Small arms and legs, tiny bat wings and a short spade-tipped tail appear.
stades.ado: The body becomes tall and slender, the flame crown grows into four horns and black armor plates appear on the shoulders.
stades.adulte: A towering demon lord with vast black-and-red wings, a crown of six burning horns, spiked obsidian armor, a flaming scepter and a long purple cape.
stades.ancien: An elder sovereign with a long white flame beard, cracked horns set with relic gems, a halo of black fire and a scepter used as a cane.
